summary: Bègles regulates street parking mainly through a blue zone (zone bleue) introduced in 2020 that now covers nearly a third of the commune, with free resident passes and a two-hour limit for others; the commune said in October 2026 that it is tackling pavement parking and abandoned cars as the population grew by nearly 10,000 in 20 years. It is also consulting on the north-west traffic plan. Off-street, the public Les Sécheries multi-storey car park (405 spaces on the operator's page, 30 with EV charging) is run by the metropolitan body METPARK at 0.60 euro per 15 minutes, with a 50 euro resident monthly subscription, while TBM lists two park-and-rides in Bègles (Rostand on tram A with 204 spaces and Bègles Station on tram C with 193). The Bordeaux Métropole low-emission zone inside the ring road has applied since January 2025 and only bars unclassified vehicles; the Bègles park-and-rides are not among the 11 open to them. Euratlantique's Bègles Garonne zone plans up to 5,000 homes, but we found no official parking figures for it.

items.text: In an article of 15 October 2026 the commune said Bègles has 356 recorded streets, has grown by nearly 10,000 residents in 20 years and many households now own two or more cars. It said it cannot guarantee a space in front of every home and that it is targeting pavement parking and abandoned 'voitures ventouses'.
items.source_title: Stationnement à Bègles : mieux partager l’espace public

items.text: Bègles has run a blue zone (zone bleue) since 2020 that now covers nearly a third of the commune, including the north-west districts, Terres Neuves and Terre Sud and Place du Bicentenaire, and adds two nearby car parks (26 and 30 spaces). It applies Monday to Saturday 9am-7pm; non-residents may stay at most 2 hours with a disc, residents holding a free Pass'Zone Bleue (at most two per household) may park without limit. Fines range from 35 to 135 euros (page last updated 18 April 2025).

The same page links the blue zone to the arrival of the Bus Express, saying three major roads are being made one-way and some central streets (around Route de Toulouse and Cours Victor Hugo) are being opened to resident parking rights. Outside the blue zone, on-street parking in some streets alternates by half-month between odd and even sides.

The commune opened a consultation in October 2026 on the traffic plan of the north-west district (La Ferrade, La Castagne, La Raze), which had been introduced four years earlier to cut through-traffic. A public feedback meeting is planned for the first quarter of 2027.
items.source_title: Circulation dans le quartier Nord-Ouest : votre avis compte

items.text: Bordeaux Métropole's low-emission zone has applied since 1 January 2025 inside the ring road, 24/7; in the version updated 13 January 2026, only vehicles that cannot get a Crit'Air sticker (unclassified) are barred from driving or parking, and a Crit'Air sticker is required. The 11 park-and-rides open to such vehicles do not include the two in Bègles (Rostand and Bègles Station).
items.source_title: ZFE (Zone à Faibles Émissions) : ce qu’il faut savoir

items.text: The Les Sécheries car park (13 allée de Francs) is run by METPARK, the public body of Bordeaux Métropole. Page read on 21 October 2026: 405 spaces, of which 30 have EV charging and 19 are bike places, covered, open 24/7, maximum height 2.10 m, no reservation.

METPARK page for Les Sécheries, read on 21 October 2026: 0.60 euro per 15 minutes up to 4 hours, then 9 euros from 4 to 24 hours; night rate 5 euros (20:00-07:00 beyond 1h30). Monthly subscription 70 euros, weekly 35 euros, resident monthly 50 euros, motorbike monthly 30 euros.

METPARK describes itself as a public industrial and commercial body (EPIC) running 36 car parks in 7 communes of the metropolis with over 15,000 spaces, 11,000 subscribers and 3.6 million customers in 2025. Its resident subscription gives a reduced price to people living within 1 km of a METPARK car park (page read on 21 October 2026).

METPARK's 2023-2026 plan, as stated on its page read on 21 October 2026, is to install 1,500 EV charge points in 26 car parks through a public concession, to convert its bike rooms into METSTATION bike facilities by 2026, and to invest over 25 million euros to renovate 4 car parks. Charging uses TotalEnergies points, payable by QR code, bank card or badge.

TBM's park-and-ride list (read on 21 October 2026) shows two sites in Bègles: Rostand (avenue Lénine, tram A, 204 spaces, 2.10 m height limit) and Bègles Station (avenue Lénine, tram C, 193 spaces, 4 disabled spaces, 5 car-sharing spaces). They are open to all; park-and-rides open when trams run and a 15 euro daily fine applies to cars left outside operating hours.
items.source_title: Opening times, maps and list of Parcs-Relais (TBM)

items.text: A commune page of 20 May 2025 (updated 4 June 2025) said tram C would not run between Quinconces and Pyrénées from 2 June to 31 August 2025 because of switch works at Porte de Bourgogne, which will create new tram lines E and F; line F is to link Bègles station directly to the airport in about one hour. For the Fête de la Morue it pointed car drivers to the paid METPARK Les Sécheries car park.
items.source_title: Comment vous rendre à la Fête de la Morue ?

items.text: Bordeaux Métropole's open-data record for Bègles Les Sécheries (read on 21 October 2026) lists METPARK as owner and operator, a 3-level multi-storey car park in service since 2016, with 405 total spaces, 9 disabled, 8 EV and 19 bike spaces. It also feeds a real-time free-space counter that uses a smaller total than the 405 shown in the static fields, and it lists 8 EV spaces where METPARK's own page says 30.
items.source_title: Bordeaux Métropole open data, dataset st_park_p (Parcs de stationnement)

items.text: The same open-data dataset (read on 21 October 2026) lists one other public car park in Bègles, the 193-space surface Parc Relais Gare de Bègles, operated by Keolis and in service since 2015; it uses a park-and-ride tariff (2-hour price 4.50 euros in the record).
items.source_title: Bordeaux Métropole open data, dataset st_park_p (Parcs de stationnement)

items.text: Bordeaux Métropole said in a page updated 28 May 2025 that its on-street charging network had 364 charge spaces at 146 stations, and that from 6 January 2025 charging is billed at 0.38 euro per kWh plus 4 euros per hour of immobilisation after 4 hours (not between 23:00 and 08:00 on slow AC points). This is metropolis-wide, not specific to Bègles.

A local media report of 7 November 2025 on the TBM announcement said new tram lines E and F would start on 6 December 2025, with F linking Bègles station, Saint-Jean station, Pellegrin hospital and Mérignac airport in about 45 minutes, every 10 minutes in the day. This is a pre-launch announcement; we did not confirm the service from an official TBM page.
items.source_title: Deux nouveaux trams prochainement mis en ligne à Bordeaux (Le Bonbon)

items.text: Bordeaux Euratlantique's page (last updated 29 August 2025) says the Bègles Garonne development zone covers 80 hectares in north-east Bègles with up to 5,000 homes and 140,000 square metres of business floor space planned. Its Bègles Faisceau page says the metropolitan RER is expected to serve Bègles station. Neither page states parking numbers.
items.source_title: ZAC Bègles Garonne / Bègles Faisceau (Bordeaux Euratlantique)

gaps: https://stationnement.mairie-begles.fr/ (commune parking portal) returned an empty JavaScript page; Bègles pay-and-display or resident tariffs beyond the blue zone were not found.
https://www.infotbm.com/sites/default/files/TBM_PARC_RELAIS_WEB.pdf has no extractable text (image only); park-and-ride fares for Bègles were not confirmed from an official page.
Whether Bègles lies inside the ring-road low-emission zone perimeter is not stated on the Bordeaux Métropole page read; only the list of 11 permitted park-and-rides was read.

No usable official page found on Euratlantique station-area parking or on Bus Express lines serving Bègles; sudouest.fr and actu.fr could not be searched (blocked for the search tool) and press coverage of Bègles parking was not read.
Open-data record shows Parc Relais Gare de Bègles with status closed at read time, unexplained; Rostand park-and-ride (tram A) was not found in the Bègles open-data records.
Conflict on Sécheries EV count (30 on METPARK page vs 8 in open data) and total (405 vs a smaller counter figure) is unresolved.
